SELECT user_id as userId, user_name as userName, avatar, sex, (select um.money from user_money um where um.user_id=subquery.user_id) as userMoney, ifnull(MAX( order_duration ),0) AS duration, ordersCount, vipIcon FROM ( -- 子查询用于计算每个人的订单时长 SELECT u.user_id,u.user_name,u.avatar,u.sex,count(*) as ordersCount,v.vip_icon as vipIcon, sum(TIMESTAMPDIFF( second, STR_TO_DATE( o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ), STR_TO_DATE( o.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ))) AS order_duration FROM orders o LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id=o.user_id left join vip v on v.vip_index=u.vip_index where o.status in (4,6) and u.user_id is not null
and date_format(o.pay_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(now(),'%Y-%m')
-- 将 startTime 从 varchar 转换为日期类型，并筛选出上个月的记录 and STR_TO_DATE(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') BETWEEN -- 获取上个月的第一天 DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND -- 获取上个月的最后一天 LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))
-- 将 starTime 从 varchar 转换为日期时间类型，并筛选本周的记录 and STR_TO_DATE(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') BETWEEN -- 获取本周的第一天（周一） DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND -- 获取本周的最后一天（周日） DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
-- 将 starTime 从 varchar 转换为日期时间类型，并筛选上周的记录 and STR_TO_DATE(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') BETWEEN -- 获取上周的第一天（周一） DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 1 WEEK) AND -- 获取上周的最后一天（周日） DATE_SUB(DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY), INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
and o.tearoom_id in (select tearoom_id from tearoom where tearoom_city like concat('%',#{city},'%'))
and o.tearoom_id = #{tearoomId}
and o.tearoom_id in (select tearoom_id from tearoom where tearoom_name like concat('%',#{tearoomName},'%'))
and u.user_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
and u.phone like concat('%',#{phone},'%')
and date_format(o.pay_time,'%Y-%m-%d')>=date_format(#{startTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(o.pay_time,'%Y-%m-%d')<=date_format(#{endTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
GROUP BY user_id ) AS subquery GROUP BY user_id order by duration desc
